name=Stellux Native
version=1.0.0

compiler.cpp.cmd=g++
compiler.sdk.path={runtime.tools.{build.sdk}.path}

build.sdk=alpha-sdk
build.extra_flags=

recipe.cpp.o.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.cpp.cmd}" -c {build.extra_flags} "-I{compiler.sdk.path}/include" "{source_file}" -o "{object_file}"
